title: Ignore label churn during the pre-publish refresh

rubric.text: Treats the removed `ready-for-agent` label as neither a readiness failure nor a material change, so it does not block publication or require renewed approval
Still reapplies the refresh checks to issue state, body, comments, blockers, implementation PRs, `HEAD`, the working tree, and plan markers before publishing
Does not restore the label or change any other issue or Project state
